build_order: 0. hygiene: docs, scripts and ledger only, no Rust hot files. Can start at once and run alongside unit 1.

1. s3-corrections. This is a NEW unit carved out of the s7, s9 and redteam specs: the S2/S3 defects that go live as soon as AGENT_CONTINUE_AFTER_APPROVAL_ENABLED is on. It must land before S6/S7, which build on it. (a) mp-contracts: continuation_mode_for(persistent, enabled), with callers passing !req.zdr && !ctx.route.is_waived(); Authority::narrows gains a mode rank (deny<ask<auto, unknown widest) and rung_rank ranks unspecified/unknown as 3 (widest); new src/durable_gate.rs holds DurableStore, refuse_unless_persistent and refuse_unless_persistent_class. (b) execution-core effect.rs: reserve returns ReserveOutcome{Created, AlreadyReserved}; agent.rs phase 2 never dispatches on AlreadyReserved and closes the call as closer_text(UnknownOutcome). (c) resume.rs: effective_authority, apply_authority, next_segment_no and resumed_step_id, applied in prepare_resume so stage 1 runs under the snapshot authority; the segment number is derived by the executor and AgentResume.segment_no is ignored, not refused. (d) agent.rs pause sites ~2215 and ~4646: cold mode "" when the run is waived or !resume::releasable(tool). (e) model-gateway sse.rs: continue_preflight refuses an approval with consumed_at set (409 continuation_already_consumed) and a non-persistent turn (409 not_resumable); continue_run sends segment_no 0; zdr_posture.rs DURABLE_MUTATIONS lists continue_run. (f) session-core orchestration_store.rs: CONSUME_APPROVAL_SQL joins runs and requires retention_class='persistent' and status NOT IN (completed, failed, cancelled). (g) deploy/docker-compose.yml: model-gateway gets AGENT_CONTINUE_AFTER_APPROVAL_ENABLED (verified: only execution-core has it, at line 1042).

2. s4-leftovers: runs.proto RunDetail resumable=17 and park_reason=18; the run_service_grpc read path; loop_checkpoint.rs ended-run guard on save/claim; park_reason validation; removal of the stale-active claim branch; claim_held; purge-path DB tests; the CI loop_checkpoint step. It also owns ParkReason::as_str/parse/ALL in mp-contracts. Can run in parallel with unit 1 on the conditions in parallel_groups.

3. s9-proofs, static part only: execution-core tests/loop_fold_zdr_matrix.rs and tests/durable_loop_contract.rs, the vendored zdr-posture-matrix.json with its .sha256 and zdr-contract-sync rows, and the model-gateway tests/zdr_posture_matrix.rs /continue case. Starts after unit 1; can run in parallel with unit 4.

4. s6-fold-writer: execution-core runtime_loop/fold.rs, scrub.rs scrub_fold, agent.rs E1-E6, and the mp-contracts loop_fold.rs additions (tombstone, is_resumable, contains_credential_shape, FoldCompleted.call_id, prompt_digest).

5. s7a: session-core ListToolActions (sessions.proto add-only, tool_ledger.rs list_actions, grpc.rs handler, plus stubs in every sessions-trait double) and execution-core effect.rs list_actions. Can start once unit 2 is merged; it touches no execution-core loop file.
6. s7b: execution-core resume.rs restore and restore_in_place; agent.rs RoundSeed::InPlace; consume_for_resume/build_segment split; closers.rs dead_code removal. Must follow unit 4.
7. s7c: model-gateway continue_run pre-consume plus resume_mode_for (needs RunDetail.resumable from unit 2), and the BFF orchestration.rs error-code passthrough. Must follow units 1 and 6.
8. ui-plan-approval-gap (WS14 S2a), only after human sign-off. It touches model-gateway sse.rs spawn_run_dispatch/agentic_run_stream and the SPA; serialize it after unit 7 because both edit sse.rs.
9. s8-parking: NO-GO until amended (see go_no_go). When amended it goes last: mp-contracts consts, protos, then session-core worker, then execution-core park.rs.
10. s9 live proofs (durable-loop-live-proof.sh stages s3/s5): lead only, after unit 1 and the human decisions; s7/s8 stages after their units.
parallel_groups: Group A, runs at once: hygiene (new scripts under apps/Model Plane/scripts, the docs runbook, the plan doc tail, the ledger.md entry) in parallel with everything. Its only shared file is apps/Model Plane/docs/decisions/ledger.md: hygiene inserts its entry above the 2026-10-16 heading first, and every later unit appends below it, never in parallel edits.

Group B: s3-corrections in parallel with s4-leftovers, on three conditions. (1) mp-contracts src/loop_fold.rs is edited by s4-leftovers first (the ParkReason impl block) and by s3-corrections second (continuation_mode_for, narrows, rung_rank), sequentially, in non-overlapping hunks. (2) s4-leftovers does not touch session-core orchestration_store.rs, which s3-corrections owns. (3) s4-leftovers' grpc.rs edit is limited to the test-only raw cancel at ~13402 and new DB tests. Cargo serializes on the target lock regardless, so run tests one crate at a time.

Group C: s9 static (new test files plus the repo-root scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh) in parallel with s6. Disjoint as long as the s9 crate-internal waived call-site test in agent.rs moves into s3-corrections (amended) and S9 adds no agent.rs or sse.rs edits.

Group D: s7a (session-core tool_ledger.rs, grpc.rs, sessions.proto, the trait doubles) can run in parallel with s6, provided the execution-core MockSession stub for list_tool_actions is added by whichever unit lands second, as one small hunk next to claim_loop_checkpoint (~agent.rs 6394). Otherwise s7a's MockSession hunk waits for s6.

Strictly sequential, never in parallel: every unit that edits execution-core runtime_loop/agent.rs (s3-corrections, then s6, then s7b, then s8) and every unit that edits model-gateway src/sse.rs (s3-corrections, then s7c, then ui-plan-approval-gap, then s8).

shared_interfaces.name: pause_ref for an approval pause
shared_interfaces.definition: pause_ref = format!("{}:{}", run_id, step_id), the approval's existing idempotency key (verified at agent.rs:4669; client_approval_id is empty at :4665, so session-core mints the approval id). The pause fold is saved BEFORE CreateApproval. S7 claims with format!("{run_id}:{consumed.step_id}"), never with the approval_id. S7 spec section F, 'save after create_approval / pause_ref = approval id', is overruled.

shared_interfaces.name: Approval continuation_mode values
shared_interfaces.definition: Only "" (cold) and "loop" are ever minted. "loop" requires persistent (not zdr, not waived) and releasable(tool) and continue_enabled(). The S6 'segment' approval mode and S6's widening of continue_preflight to accept "segment" are DROPPED. A pause whose fold failed to save stays "loop", and /continue then falls back to stage 1 (claim not_claimable). The stage is chosen only by AgentResume.mode.

shared_interfaces.name: LoopFoldV1 writer contract
shared_interfaces.definition: rounds_executed counts rounds STARTED, including the open round when round_in_flight is Some. round_in_flight.calls lists every model call in original order; step_id is "" for a call rejected in phase 1, with FoldCompleted.call_id (new, serde default, skip if empty) used for matching; the S6 synthetic 'rejected_{i}' step ids are dropped. completed excludes the pending call. extensions{effect_ledger:true} (EXT_EFFECT_LEDGER); a tombstone carries extensions.not_resumable (EXT_NOT_RESUMABLE). authority = resume::offered_authority(..). prompt_digest = mp_contracts::loop_fold::prompt_digest(compose_system_prompt(allowlist), tools as (name, description, parameters_json)) as S7 defines it: blake3, domain tag mp.prompt.v1, length-prefixed, tools sorted. This replaces S6's 'first system message' digest. A golden fixture pinning this shape goes in mp-contracts tests/loop_fold_golden.rs.

shared_interfaces.name: fold::Snapshot / build_fold / FoldWriter
shared_interfaces.definition: As in the S6 interfaces block (pub(crate) in execution-core runtime_loop/fold.rs). There is no LoopState refactor: S7's references to 'S6 LoopState' and S8's LoopState::to_fold / LoopSnapshot are replaced by fold::Snapshot plus build_fold(&Snapshot, Option<RoundInFlight>, Option<PendingPause>). S7 adds FoldWriter::seeded(channel, bearer, run_id, expected_seq: u64, segment_no: u32); S8 adds FoldWriter::save_park(fold, park_ref, ParkReason, park_until) -> Result<u64, SaveError>.

shared_interfaces.name: SaveError classification of loop_checkpoint_run_ended
shared_interfaces.definition: s4-leftovers adds FailedPrecondition 'loop_checkpoint_run_ended' on save and claim. S6 classify_status maps it like Closed (writer Failed, no retry, effects held). Add it to the session_core_refusals_are_classified table.

shared_interfaces.name: ReserveOutcome
shared_interfaces.definition: execution-core effect.rs: pub(crate) enum ReserveOutcome { Created, AlreadyReserved }, built from ReserveToolActionResponse.created, which reserve() currently discards (verified at effect.rs ~142, .map(|_| ())). On AlreadyReserved an effectful call is never dispatched; its outcome is failed with closer_text(CloserKind::UnknownOutcome, tool).

shared_interfaces.name: effective_authority / apply_authority / segment numbering
shared_interfaces.definition: resume.rs: effective_authority(paused:&Authority, req:&pb::RunAgentRequest)->Result<Authority, Refusal> and apply_authority(&mut req, &Authority), per the S7 table C. They apply to stage 1 now and stage 2 later. next_segment_no(paused_step_id)->u32 (leading s{n}. then n+1, else 2) and resumed_step_id(n, original)='s{n}.'+original. The gateway sends segment_no 0; the executor ignores the field (it does not refuse non-zero) so a rolling deploy with an old gateway keeps working. S9 validate_continue_resume must NOT refuse a non-zero segment_no.

shared_interfaces.name: Authority::narrows
shared_interfaces.definition: mp-contracts loop_fold.rs: mode_rank(deny 0, ask 1, auto 2, other 3) is checked; rung_rank(danger_full_access 2, workspace_write 1, read_only 0, unspecified/empty/unknown 3). Tests: an_unspecified_or_unknown_rung_is_never_narrower_than_a_graded_one and a_resume_may_not_widen_the_permission_mode.

shared_interfaces.name: durable_gate (DurableStore)
shared_interfaces.definition: NEW mp-contracts src/durable_gate.rs: enum DurableStore{Fold, Consume, Continue, Park}; refuse_unless_persistent(store, &Resolution); refuse_unless_persistent_class(store, &str); continuation_mode_for(persistent, enabled). Placed in its own file so it does not collide with loop_fold.rs hunks. S9 static tests consume it.

shared_interfaces.name: RunDetail.resumable=17, park_reason=18
shared_interfaces.definition: runs.proto (verified: the highest tag is metadata=16). resumable = store switch on && retention persistent && run not ended && fold state in (paused, parked) or (resuming with an expired lease). park_reason is set only when resumable and parked. The projection lives in run_service_grpc RUN_SELECT via LEFT JOIN, with no content columns. S7c's resume_mode_for and S8 consume it; S8 must NOT re-add the projection.

shared_interfaces.name: ParkReason wire strings
shared_interfaces.definition: mp-contracts loop_fold.rs: impl ParkReason { pub const ALL:[Self;5]; pub const fn as_str(self)->&'static str; pub fn parse(&str)->Option<Self> }, with credential_window, provider_exhausted, upstream_unavailable, crash_interrupted and reauth_required equal to the serde snake_case names. S8 consumes it and adds only MAX_PARKS_PER_RUN, PARKS_EXTENSION_KEY and parks_in.

shared_interfaces.name: ClaimLoopCheckpoint status contract
shared_interfaces.definition: Aborted 'loop_checkpoint_claim_held' when state=resuming, the claim hash matches this token and the lease is live. FailedPrecondition 'loop_checkpoint_not_claimable' | 'loop_checkpoint_run_ended' | 'loop_checkpoint_disabled'; DURABLE_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN. The stale-active branch (active and not written for 900 s, any pause_ref) is REMOVED: claimable states are paused, parked, and resuming with an expired lease. A crashed active fold becomes claimable only after S8's worker crash-parks it.

shared_interfaces.name: Fencing after a claim
shared_interfaces.definition: There is no claim_token field on Save. The fence is the seq compare-and-set plus this rule: an in-place resume saves a fold (kind pre_effect, expected_seq = claimed seq) BEFORE dispatching ANY call of the resumed round, the read-only release included. Of two claimants holding the same seq, only one save can win; the loser gets loop_checkpoint_stale and is refused with resume_checkpoint_unavailable before any dispatch.

shared_interfaces.name: ListToolActions RPC
shared_interfaces.definition: sessions.proto add-only: rpc ListToolActions(ListToolActionsRequest{string run_id=1; repeated string action_ids=2;}) returns (ListToolActionsResponse{repeated ToolActionState actions=1;}); ToolActionState{action_id=1, tool=2, status=3, effect_class=4, args_digest=5, closed_by=6}. At most 64 ids. Authorization is session:read + authorize_run_owner(Read) + refuse_zdr_continuation; zdr rows are omitted; digest only.

shared_interfaces.name: Gateway /continue pre-consume
shared_interfaces.definition: continue_run calls ConsumeApproval with the user bearer BEFORE agentic_run_stream: 409 continuation_already_consumed (another claim), 404 approval_not_found, 409 for approval_not_granted, approval_expired and approval_not_resumable. Until s7c lands, s3-corrections' consumed_at check in continue_preflight is the gate. The BFF passes the closed upstream codes through instead of model_error.

shared_interfaces.name: Switches
shared_interfaces.definition: EXECUTION_LOOP_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED (s6; requires EXECUTION_EFFECT_LEDGER_ENABLED and SESSION_CORE_LOOP_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED). EXECUTION_LOOP_RESUME_ENABLED (s7; execution-core and model-gateway; requires the S6 switch, otherwise 'loop' is downgraded to segment). EXECUTION_LOOP_PARKING_ENABLED and SESSION_CORE_PARK_TTL_SECONDS (s8). All default false in compose. Parsing: one shared strict parser, mp_contracts::loop_fold::switch_from(Option<&str>), accepting case-insensitive 'true' only, owned by s6 and used by every new switch. The existing continue_after_approval_from (1/true/on/yes) stays as it is, and is recorded as a known inconsistency.

conflicts_resolved.issue: pause_ref and save order: S6 wants the idempotency key and a save before CreateApproval; S7 wants the approval id and a save after CreateApproval.
conflicts_resolved.decision: S6 wins. The fold is durable before the approval is visible, and the key {run_id}:{step_id} is already sent (agent.rs:4669). S7 derives the ref from ConsumeApprovalResponse.step_id. If CreateApproval fails after the fold saved, S6 closes the fold with CloseLoopCheckpoint(..,'approval_not_created').

conflicts_resolved.issue: A 'segment' approval mode for a failed pause fold, and widening continue_preflight to accept 'segment'.
conflicts_resolved.decision: Dropped. The approval stays 'loop' and the fallback happens at claim time (stage 1). This removes the gateway preflight change and a third approval mode.

conflicts_resolved.issue: prompt_digest definition: S6 uses the first system message text; S7 recomputes it from compose_system_prompt plus the tool definitions.
conflicts_resolved.decision: S7's definition, via the shared mp-contracts prompt_digest(system_prompt, tools). S6 computes it at save time from the same inputs. Its implementation lands with S6 in mp-contracts.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Matching rejected calls: S6 uses synthetic 'rejected_{i}' step ids; S7 adds FoldCompleted.call_id.
conflicts_resolved.decision: FoldCompleted.call_id (additive, serde default), with an empty step_id for rejected calls. S6 owns the mp-contracts edit.

conflicts_resolved.issue: S7 assumes an S6 LoopState refactor.
conflicts_resolved.decision: No LoopState. S6 option (b) stands. S7b restores the locals from resume::Restored inside run_rounds' RoundSeed::InPlace init block, next to the existing seeded_round handling.

conflicts_resolved.issue: S8 assumed FoldWriter::save_park and LoopState::to_fold, and defined its own LoopSnapshot.
conflicts_resolved.decision: S8 uses fold::Snapshot and build_fold, and adds save_park to fold.rs itself, after S6 is merged. LoopSnapshot is deleted from the S8 design.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Both own RunDetail resumable=17/park_reason=18 and the RUN_SELECT projection, and both validate park_reason on save.
conflicts_resolved.decision: s4-leftovers owns the proto fields, the projection and the closed-token park_reason validation, plus ParkReason::parse/as_str. S8 adds only the TTL (park_until_beyond_ttl) and the cap (park_limit_reached) checks in save.

conflicts_resolved.issue: claim_held distinction and the stale-active claim branch in loop_checkpoint::claim; resumable semantics.
conflicts_resolved.decision: s4-leftovers implements claim_held and removes the stale-active branch, which is a hijack today (any pause_ref after 900 s). The resumable definition is s4's: paused, parked, or resuming with an expired lease.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Segment numbering: S9 has the builder send 0 and the validator refuse non-zero; S7 has the executor derive it.
conflicts_resolved.decision: The executor derives it from the paused step-id prefix. The validator ignores segment_no, so an old gateway sending 2 still works. This lands in s3-corrections.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Second /continue: S9 refuses a consumed approval in preflight (409); S7 relies on a same-claim retry to recover from crashes and puts consume in the gateway.
conflicts_resolved.decision: s3-corrections: preflight refuses consumed_at set, for every caller including a same-token retry, because a same-claim replay on stage 1 can re-execute when the ledger is off. S7c then adds pre-consume, which also closes the simultaneous race. S7's matrix rows 6/7 ('same-token retry works') are amended: recovery after a crash post-consume is S8 park TTL / outcome_unknown. This needs a human confirmation (see human_decisions).

conflicts_resolved.issue: Stage-1 authority gap (rung from the per-replica grant store, floor 0, plan false) and the fail-open narrows(): S7 fixes them inside S7.
conflicts_resolved.decision: Moved into s3-corrections. This is a live widening as soon as the continue flag is on, independent of folds.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Non-releasable tools get loop-mode approvals and are stranded after consume (found independently by all three specs).
conflicts_resolved.decision: Fixed once, in s3-corrections: cold mode "" when !resume::releasable(tool) (make releasable pub(crate)), at both agent.rs sites (~2215 offered snapshot, ~4646 CreateApproval).

conflicts_resolved.issue: Two disposable-Postgres runners: durable-loop-proof.sh (S9) and session-core-db-tests.sh (hygiene).
conflicts_resolved.decision: One runner: hygiene's session-core-db-tests.sh. S9's anti-skip checks are merged into it: a grep that fails on 'skipping: DATABASE_URL unset' (verified: loop_checkpoint.rs:465 prints it and returns early) and a per-filter minimum pass count. durable-loop-proof.sh and its -test.sh are dropped. S9 keeps only the live-proof runner (gated) and the static tests.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Purge-path DB tests are specified in both.
conflicts_resolved.decision: s4-leftovers owns them (loop_checkpoint_* names). S9's every_purge_path_removes_the_fold is dropped.

conflicts_resolved.issue: S9 places the fixes (F1-F7), the waived consume DB test and the agent.rs waived call-site test inside S9.
conflicts_resolved.decision: All of them move to s3-corrections, test first. S9 keeps only new test files that turn green after s3-corrections.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Both change model-gateway sse.rs agentic_run_stream/continue_run signatures.
conflicts_resolved.decision: Serialized: s7c first. The UI gap adds the execute_granted parameter afterwards, and continue_run passes false.

conflicts_resolved.decision: Wrong. docs/compliance/evidence/live-proof-ws03-s5-effect-ledger-2026-10-17.txt exists, untracked, per git status. The ledger links that file, and the lead commits it with hygiene.
